title: Goods Gone Back and the Spend Circle Points Are Earned On
content:
## Goods that have gone back

Where the profile holds a return authorisation under Northbeam Returns and Restocking, what has gone back is
taken off the spend reward points on a Northbeam Circle Membership are earned on, so that points are not
earned on merchandise the profile no longer has.

1. Where the return authorisation the profile holds stands inspected or settled and a refund was authorised on
   it in the three months ending on the handling day, the refund authorised on that return in that window is
   taken off the spend.
2. Where that return stands authorised or received and no refund has yet been authorised on it, the purchase
   price recorded on that return is taken off the spend.
3. Where neither of those holds, nothing is taken off the spend for goods going back, and 0.00 comes off on
   this account.

## Which figure each reading uses

The first reading uses the refund authorised on the return, counted over the three months ending on the
handling day. The second uses the purchase price recorded on the return itself, whatever its age. A return
standing in any other way, and a return standing authorised or received on which a refund has already been
authorised, both fall to the third reading.

## Cases

A return standing settled with a refund of 365.00 authorised last month takes 365.00 off the spend. The same
return with its only refund authorised six months ago takes nothing off, because that refund falls outside
the three months and the return does not stand authorised or received.

A return standing received with no refund yet authorised takes off the purchase price recorded on it — on a
hypothetical purchase price of 812.00, that is 812.00. A return standing authorised on which a refund was
authorised inside the three months ending on the handling day falls to the third reading, and nothing comes
off on this account.
